domain.description: All permutations preserving the blocks {1,...,7} and {8,...,14}.
domain.image: The specific recursively defined source map f14.

comparison: For every input and every 1<=r,c<=14, the northwest rank of the input is at least the northwest rank of its image. Zero row/column ranks are identically zero.

limits.wall_semantics: The earlier of 1500 seconds and the caller-supplied absolute UTC stop time.

limitations: Finite experimental check, not a Lean kernel proof or an all-size theorem; the conjecture remains open.
No global novelty claim; bounded named-source literature scope.
RSS sampling can miss transient peaks and overshoot the threshold. Child RSS is distinct from static application-owned storage; runtime/library storage is excluded from the static bound.
The independent point evaluator is used in source controls and for a candidate, not redundantly on every successful input.
Timing and binary hashes describe the executed build; later builds need not reproduce timing or executable bytes.
